Project.Name: QLDA Integration Middleware - Excel to Odoo
Project.Title: QLDA Integration Middleware Project Plan
Project.Subject: MVP product catalog import, Excel to Odoo test environment

Task.Name: QLDA Integration Middleware — provisional 12-week baseline
Task.Notes: Provisional start 2026-11-23; 5-day, 8-hour calendar; public holidays and class schedule are not configured. Update before approving baseline.

Task.Name: Confirm project scope and charter
Task.Notes: Confirm one-way Excel-to-Odoo product-import scope, assumptions, objectives, limits and acceptance targets. | M1 scope and charter agreed

Task.Name: Identify stakeholders and collect requirements
Task.Notes: Interview or structured-review the instructor, an ERP data-entry user and Odoo administrator; record needs and constraints. | User needs and requirements

Task.Name: Profile Excel data and Odoo product fields
Task.Notes: Inspect representative rows, required columns, types, duplicate SKU patterns and target Odoo fields. | Sample data and field inventory

Task.Name: Prove Odoo API access
Task.Notes: Verify sandbox availability, authentication, permissions and one safe test write; document fallback if unavailable. | M2 API access proof or fallback

Task.Name: Approve data dictionary and acceptance criteria
Task.Notes: Specify source-to-target fields, validation rules, duplicate policy and measurable acceptance evidence. | Mapping and acceptance baseline

Task.Name: Design modular middleware architecture
Task.Notes: Define file intake, validation, mapping, Odoo adapter, batch handling, logging and extension points. | Architecture and interfaces

Task.Name: Design security and failure handling
Task.Notes: Define credential handling, least privilege, safe retry boundaries, idempotency key and manual reconciliation state. | Credential and recovery design

Task.Name: Prepare test plan and test data
Task.Notes: Prepare 12 scenario-based cases and a synthetic product file, including invalid, duplicate and API-failure cases. | 12 proposed test cases

Task.Name: Build Excel parser
Task.Notes: Read the agreed .xlsx template and produce normalized product records with source row references. | Parser with row tracking

Task.Name: Build validation and duplicate checks
Task.Notes: Check required fields, numeric types, allowed values and duplicates in file or target; reject unsafe rows. | Validation rules

Task.Name: Build field mapping and transformation
Task.Notes: Map normalized records to target product fields using an editable mapping configuration. | Field transformation

Task.Name: Build Odoo adapter and authentication
Task.Notes: Implement the selected API adapter and isolated credential configuration for the test environment. | Safe test write

Task.Name: Build batch orchestration and audit log
Task.Notes: Process rows independently, capture status and correlation IDs, and place ambiguous outcomes into reconciliation. | M3 end-to-end MVP feature complete

Task.Name: Build configuration and run interface
Task.Notes: Provide a simple command or minimal screen to select a file, start a batch and inspect results. | Repeatable operator workflow

Task.Name: Run unit and component tests
Task.Notes: Test parser, validation, mapping, duplicate detection and adapter behavior in isolation. | Unit/component results

Task.Name: Run end-to-end integration tests
Task.Notes: Test the full path against a safe Odoo sandbox and verify target records and logs. | M4 integration test evidence

Task.Name: Fix defects and repeat failed tests
Task.Notes: Prioritize defects by data loss, duplicate creation, blocking errors and usability; rerun affected cases. | Retest and defect disposition

Task.Name: Conduct acceptance demonstration
Task.Notes: Demonstrate valid import, rejected rows, duplicate prevention and traceable outcome to the reviewer. | M5 acceptance demo

Task.Name: Control the project and report progress
Task.Notes: Maintain MS Project baseline, issue/decision log, weekly status, scope control and risk review across 12 weeks. | Weekly; parallel from project start; effort included in baseline

Task.Name: Prepare installation and user guide
Task.Notes: Document prerequisites, configuration, safe test procedure, results and known limitations. | Installation and user guide

Task.Name: Prepare final report, slides and demo
Task.Notes: Connect project evidence to the assignment criteria and distinguish actual test results from estimates. | M6 final handover

Task.Name: Close and capture lessons learned
Task.Notes: Review acceptance, remaining risks, effort variance and reusable learning. | Lessons learned and closeout

Task.Name: Scope and charter approved
Task.Notes: Project milestone; evidence and acceptance record required. | M1 | Week 1 baseline; replace with approved actual date.

Task.Name: Odoo API proof or fallback decision
Task.Notes: Project milestone; evidence and acceptance record required. | M2 | Week 2 baseline; replace with approved actual date.

Task.Name: Data mapping and architecture approved
Task.Notes: Project milestone; evidence and acceptance record required. | M3 | Week 3 baseline; replace with approved actual date.

Task.Name: MVP feature complete
Task.Notes: Project milestone; evidence and acceptance record required. | M4 | Week 8 baseline; replace with approved actual date.

Task.Name: Acceptance demonstration complete
Task.Notes: Project milestone; evidence and acceptance record required. | M5 | Week 11 baseline; replace with approved actual date.

Task.Name: Final handover
Task.Notes: Project milestone; evidence and acceptance record required. | M6 | Week 12 baseline; replace with approved actual date.
